tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Deep slate. Figure background in docs plots and the base of map-label halos. White text on it is 17.9:1.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: White. Map label text, halo casing base, and the cover ground. Ink text on it is 17.9:1.

tokens.name: vessel-cargo
tokens.usage: Cargo vessels: Rich Azure. Track lines in trajectories, segments and stationary layers. Map data colour, not for text.

tokens.name: vessel-commercial
tokens.usage: Aggregated 'commercial' class: the same azure as Cargo by design.

tokens.name: vessel-tanker
tokens.usage: Tankers: Deep Crimson Rose. Track lines. Map data colour, not for text.

tokens.name: vessel-tug
tokens.usage: Tugs and towing: Vibrant Amber / Tug Orange. Track lines. Map data colour, not for text.

tokens.name: vessel-passenger
tokens.usage: Passenger vessels: Turquoise / Cyan. Track lines. Map data colour, not for text.

tokens.name: vessel-pleasure
tokens.usage: Pleasure craft and sailing: Violet. Track lines. Map data colour, not for text.

tokens.name: vessel-fishing
tokens.usage: Fishing vessels: Forest Green. Track lines. Map data colour, not for text.

tokens.name: vessel-military
tokens.usage: Military: Slate Navy. Track lines. Map data colour, not for text.

tokens.name: vessel-other
tokens.usage: Other / reserved AIS types: Muted Blue-Grey. Track lines. Map data colour, not for text.

tokens.name: vessel-null
tokens.usage: Vessel group missing (NULL). Neutral grey; keep it last in legends. Map data colour, not for text.

tokens.name: encounter-crossing
tokens.usage: Crossing encounters. Encounter points and the CPA lines connecting the two ships; drawn over a white halo.

tokens.name: encounter-head-on
tokens.usage: Head-on encounters. Encounter points and the CPA lines connecting the two ships; drawn over a white halo.

tokens.name: encounter-overtaking
tokens.usage: Overtaking encounters. Encounter points and the CPA lines connecting the two ships; drawn over a white halo.

tokens.name: encounter-parallel
tokens.usage: Parallel sailing encounters (category 'parallel_sailing'). Encounter points and the CPA lines connecting the two ships; drawn over a white halo.

tokens.name: encounter-stationary
tokens.usage: Stationary encounters. Encounter points and the CPA lines connecting the two ships; drawn over a white halo.

tokens.name: encounter-null
tokens.usage: Encounter type missing (NULL). Encounter points and the CPA lines connecting the two ships; drawn over a white halo.

tokens.name: map-point
tokens.usage: Trajectorized AIS points: arrow markers rotated by course, layer opacity 0.438, outlined with map-halo.

tokens.name: map-fairway
tokens.usage: Fairway centerline (dashed) and river-mile marker fill: deep nautical teal.

tokens.name: map-fairway-section
tokens.usage: Rijkswaterstaat FIS fairway sections, layer opacity 0.8.

tokens.name: map-halo
tokens.usage: Thin white casing under points, encounter markers and CPA lines so colours read on any basemap.

tokens.name: map-halo-marker
tokens.usage: Outline of river-mile markers.

tokens.name: label-buffer
tokens.usage: Text buffer behind white map labels (0.8 mm). Paper text on it stays legible over any raster.

tokens.name: oslo-0
tokens.usage: Density ramp, low end: Crameri Oslo at 0.2 (the renderer starts Oslo at 20% so the lightest-density pixels are not black; alpha also ramps from 0.2). Default colormap for counts (config.toml style.colormap).

tokens.name: oslo-1
tokens.usage: Density ramp, 25%: Crameri Oslo. Default colormap for counts (config.toml style.colormap).

tokens.name: oslo-2
tokens.usage: Density ramp, midpoint: Crameri Oslo. Default colormap for counts (config.toml style.colormap).

tokens.name: oslo-3
tokens.usage: Density ramp, 75%: Crameri Oslo. Default colormap for counts (config.toml style.colormap).

tokens.name: oslo-4
tokens.usage: Density ramp, high end: Crameri Oslo at 1.0, the busiest lanes. Default colormap for counts (config.toml style.colormap).

tokens.name: figure-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines (dashed, 0.5) and legend frame in documentation figures on ink.

tokens.usage: Pipeline diagrams (d2): fill of data stores (cylinders).

tokens.usage: Pipeline diagrams: stroke of data stores. As text on its fill: 6.6:1.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen or sector title on a VTS console or dashboard; one per view. Paper on ink, or ink on paper.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Title of a panel, map overlay or chart card.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Overline above a group of fields or a table. Set in uppercase (text-transform), figure-muted on ink.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tug Hercules overtaking Rhine barge near km 14.2
styles.usage: Running text, list rows, alert messages.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Vessel names, emphasised row values, button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Legends, units, data sources and footnotes under charts.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Headline numbers: SOG, CPA/TCPA, counts on a KPI tile. Use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so digits don't jitter as values update.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Field values in vessel cards and tables: MMSI, IMO, COG, SOG, heading, draught. Tabular figures; right-align numeric columns.

styles.name: coordinate
styles.usage: Positions, river km and cursor coordinates in map corners.

styles.name: timestamp
styles.usage: Clocks, last-update times and event times. Always ISO date and 24h UTC (or say the zone).

styles.name: label-mile-marker
styles.usage: River-mile marker labels: 7 pt bold Sans-Serif, paper on label-buffer.

styles.name: label-fairway
styles.usage: Fairway section labels: 7 pt regular Sans-Serif, paper on label-buffer.

styles.name: figure-title
styles.usage: Plot titles: 14 pt bold, paper on ink.

styles.name: figure-tick
styles.usage: Tick and legend labels: 9 pt, figure-muted (ticks) or paper (legend) on ink.

styles.name: figure-annotation
styles.usage: Labels set on coloured partition patches: 6 pt bold paper, on the patch colour at 0.85 opacity.
